mapper.select: SELECT c.*, o.org_name AS orgName FROM agri_md_customer c LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization o ON c.org_id = o.id WHERE c.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT c.*, o.org_name AS orgName FROM agri_md_customer c LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization o ON c.org_id = o.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.del_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM agri_md_customer WHERE customer_code = #{customerCode} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT c.id, c.customer_code, c.customer_name, c.short_name, c.customer_type, c.org_id, c.credit_code, c.legal_person, c.contact_name, c.contact_phone, c.email, c.address, c.level, c.status, c.tenant_id, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.remark, o.org_name AS orgName FROM agri_md_customer c LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization o ON o.id = c.org_id
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
